correctness.rationale: The standalone verifier reconstructs the graph, exhaustively enumerates all 2597 nonempty independent sets, verifies all 1293 matching pairs and all 11430 Hasse covers, proves the Forman orientation acyclic, and obtains exactly one critical 0-cell and ten critical 4-cells. It separately verifies r and r^2 are graph automorphisms and computes exact signed simplicial chain traces, giving Lefschetz numbers 11,-1,-1 and hence H4 character 10,-2,-2. Finite-field boundary ranks over F2, F3, and F5 independently reproduce the Betti vector. No finite experiment is used as a substitute for an infinite claim; the result is a finite exact computation for this graph.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric Levi graph, and the order-three translation is intrinsic to its standard period-six LCF presentation. The character refines the known dimension of fourth homology by identifying a two-dimensional fixed subspace and four cyclotomic summands, symmetry information invisible to the nonequivariant wedge multiplicity. This is a natural equivariant invariant and a concrete step toward the full automorphism representation, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
